name: Dribbble

sources.title: Dribbble Pro pricing — Free $0 plan exists; Lite $4/mo, Standard $8/mo, Plus $99/mo (billed yearly); shot upload limits per plan
Dribbble signup — community for designers; shots, services, project briefs
Dribbble About — 'world's leading platform for discovering top designers'

requirements: Free $0 account can upload and publish Shots — the Pro page lists 'Upload & publish Shots' in the Free plan
Free plan has a per-day shot upload limit (10/day; paid tiers raise it to 15/25/50)
Content must be design work — shots, case studies, UI/branding/product design; not a generic product listing
Hiring-side features (Project Briefs, Services, InstantMatch) are gated behind Pro plans
preparation: Dribbble account (free tier suffices for posting shots)
Shot artwork — a single visual (UI screenshot, brand board, animation) is the atomic unit
Title, description, and tags for each shot
Frame a SaaS launch as design output: product UI screens, brand identity, landing page design — a raw URL drop does not fit the format
workflow: Upload a shot via the upload flow (shot image, title, description, tags)
Publish — the shot appears on your public profile and in feeds/search
Optionally attach a service or portfolio site if you want client leads (Pro features)
Repeat within your plan's daily upload limit
watchFor: The productized side (leads, services, project briefs, boosted shots) is the paid tier — don't confuse 'listed on Dribbble' with getting client leads
10 shots/day cap on Free — pace portfolio uploads
Audience is designers hiring designers; a SaaS 'launch announcement' with no design artifact will underperform
Pro pricing: Lite $4/mo, Standard $8/mo, Plus $99/mo (billed yearly) — monthly billing costs more
countsAsLive: The shot is published on the public Dribbble profile (dribbble.com/<username>) and visible in feeds/search
unknowns: Whether free accounts still need an invitation or application to post shots — the Pro page mentions 'Skip designer application process' as a Plus perk, implying a review step may exist for new posters
Discoverability differences between Free and Pro beyond the stated ranking boosts
